title: Nick Bostrom on What Happens If AI Solves All Problems
title_cn: 尼克·博斯特罗姆谈如果人工智能解决所有问题会发生什么
summary: The philosopher Nick Bostrom was one of the first thinkers who mapped out the existential risk of AI. In his 2014 book, Superintelligence: Paths, Dangers, Strategies he delved into scenarios — like the “paperclip maximizer” for instance — that showed the dangers that unfettered and highly intelligent AI posed to humans. A decade later, in Deep Utopia: Life and Meaning in a Solved World, he looked at the other side of the AI coin, and theorizes what human experience might look like if AI is capable of solving all of our problems. What happens if AI and robots can literally do every single thing better than humans can? How would we find any meaning or satisfaction from life? On this episode, he speaks to us about the two divergent ways of understanding AI's future, what we might do, and what we can do right now to improve the chances that AI actually improves our lives. title: Trump’s Aircraft Carrier Order Will Raise Costs, Contractor Says
title_cn: 承包商表示，特朗普的航母订单将增加成本
summary: President Donald Trump wants to switch the warplane launch systems on new US aircraft carriers. The company that builds those systems is suggesting that might not be a good idea.

title: Taiwan Cabinet Approves Record $35.1 Billion for Defense in 2027
title_cn: 台湾内阁批准2027年创纪录的351亿美元国防开支
summary: Taiwan’s cabinet approved a record NT$1.12 trillion ($35.1 billion) defense budget for next year, highlighting its push to deter China militarily.
